beta_zero_cost: Use the existing exact held-cost formula; no unnecessary quadrature.
reference_use: The analytic family supplies the common V Lipschitz bound and the Bellman hold-bias proof. Reference errors are only reported for calibration, never used to select checkpoints or scales.
timing: Standalone certificate cost includes previously measured common value/Lipschitz preprocessing and, when used, derivative preprocessing, plus newly measured method and problem preprocessing. Shared dynamics preprocessing is charged in full to each standalone certificate. Search/tuning totals are reported separately. Wall times are single-run implementation measurements, not complexity claims.
scope: Controlled stress test on two unchanged critics, one training seed, one analytic family. No claim of representative application workloads.
protocol: Written before the new parameter sweep. All listed settings are retained. Implementation checks may precede the sweep. No expected winner is assumed.
